data.name: Feroze
data.gender_notes: Feroze is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'Faruza', meaning 'protector' or 'victorious'. The name Feroze carries the meaning “Victorious, brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Feroze usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, bravery, and victory in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Feroze belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Feroze total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فيروز
in_arabic.meaning: حجر كريم أزرق اللون، يدل على الازدهار و الرفاهية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيروز مشتق من الفارسية و يعني الحجر الكريم ذو اللون الأزرق الغامق، و يدل على الازدهار و الرفاهية و السعادة. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الحجر بالرخاء و الثراء و يعتبر من الأحجار الكريمة النادرة.

in_urdu.name: فیروز
in_urdu.meaning: ایک قیمتی نیلا پتھر، خوشحالی اور خوش قسمتی کا نشان
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیروز ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ایک قیمتی نیلا پتھر۔ یہ پتھر خوشحالی، خوش قسمتی اور سعادت کا نشان ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، فیروز ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اچھے خصائص اور مثالی صفات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फिरोज़
in_hindi.meaning: एक कीमती नीला पत्थर, सुख और समृद्धि का प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिरोज़ एक नाम है जिसका उत्पत्ति फारसी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है एक कीमती नीला पत्थर जो सुख, समृद्धि और आनंद का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, फिरोज़ एक ऐसा नाम है जो शांति, स्थिरता और आध्यात्मिकता की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: فیروز
in_pashto.meaning: نیلې ډبرې، د خوښۍ او بریا نښه
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیروز د پښتو ژبې یو نوم دی چې معنی یې نیلې ډبرې یا آسماني رنګ دی. دا ډبره د خوښۍ، بریا او سعادت نښه ده. په پښتني روایت کې، فیروز یو داسې نوم دی چې د مثبتو ځانګړتیو او ښو صفاتو استازیتوب کوي.

in_english.name: Feroze
in_english.meaning: a precious blue stone, symbolizing prosperity and happiness
in_english.long_meaning: Feroze is a name derived from the Persian language, meaning a precious blue stone. This stone symbolizes prosperity, happiness, and well-being. In Islamic tradition, Feroze is a name that represents good qualities and ideal attributes. Its etymology can be traced back to Arabic roots, signifying a connection to the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world.

data.cultural_impact: The name Feroze has been popular in Islamic communities due to its historical significance. One of the most famous bearers of this name was Mughal Emperor Feroz Shah Tughlaq, known for his military conquests, architectural achievements, and reformist policies. It is also a common name among Muslims in India and Pakistan.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Feroze holds deep meaning for believers as it is a reminder of Allah's omnipotence and protection. Feroze signifies the victorious power of faith, as mentioned in the Quran when Prophet Yunus (Jonah) was saved from the belly of the whale and said, "My Lord is forgiving and Merciful; He brought me out after my error.” (Quran 37:161) Thus, the name inspires faith, trust, and reliance on Allah SWT in times of hardship and challenges.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Feroze: Bringer of Victory and Radiance. This name signifies the inner strength, courage, and light that shines through adversity. It is a reminder to remain steadfast and victorious in the face of challenges.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Feroz Shah Tughlaq was a sultan of the Delhi Sultanate who ruled from 1351 to 1388 CE. He is most renowned for his massive building projects and for his military campaigns, which expanded the Delhi Sultanate's territories.

Feroze Shah Mughal was the fourth son of Mughal Emperor Humayun and is the father of Emperor Akbar. He ruled the Mughal Empire from 1530 to 1545 CE, but his rule was marked by political instability and revolts.

trends: Islamic names gaining popularity in the West
Increasing multiculturalism and acceptance of diverse names
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Feroze, derived from the Persian and Arabic words meaning 'victorious' or 'conqueror', has been gaining popularity in modern contexts, particularly in the West due to the increasing acceptance of diverse names and multicultural influences. This name is commonly seen on social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram, as well as in multicultural schools and workplaces. Baby name websites and apps, which have become increasingly popular resources for parents-to-be, also frequently include Feroze as a suggested name option.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Feroze in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Feroze, which means "Victorious, brave". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
